narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rainfall to the Lehigh Valley and to Bucks County during the afternoon and early evening of July 29. As much as 2 to 3 inches of rain fell in parts of the area.
ev: Several roads in Palmerton became impassable due to flooding.
Flood waters were rushing across River Road in Plumstead Township.
